$comment: Texts: the en description is untranslated Finnish; translated here after the en name and the sv description.

Items: free-text questions whose answer is one number (counts, years, ages, durations, height, weight, doses) are retyped to integer or decimal, with a UCUM unit and generous limits that catch typos. Free-text questions that may hold several values (e.g. twins' birth weights, years of several miscarriages, sleep from–to) or clock times stay free text.
